text:
maria: quick q — do we ever store attachments in logs? noticed a 20MB pdf ended up in the debug bucket
cheng: short answer: we store a reference + metadata. but the debug bucket contained the whole file because inspect-mode pulled raw req/resp
noah: that's bad, could be PHI. how did inspect-mode decide to include binary blobs?
maria: triggered by `inspect=true` in the canary route. we didn't special-case attachments
sara: product question — customers will expect attachments to be redacted by default. can we add a policy?
cheng: proposal: never persist raw attachments in telemetry. instead store a SHA256 fingerprint salted per-tenant and an S3 link TTL'd to 7d for legal ops
noah: +1. also need to avoid extracting text from images/ocr without consent — that can pull PII into embeddings
maria: for quota/cost, sampling attachments matters. large files blow up storage and egress. suggest sample_rate=0.005 for >1MB
cheng: draft config:
```json
{
  "attachments": {
    "enabled": true,
    "sample_rate": 0.005,
    "max_size_bytes": 1000000,
    "redaction_mode": "link_only"
  }
}
```
sara: UX: console toggle called "Attach telemetry (sampled)" with inline note about retention and legal access
ops-bot: deploy job queued for canary -> cluster-a :rocket:
cheng: also add metric `telemetry.attachments.sampled_total` and `telemetry.attachments.dropped_total` for dashboards
noah: on-call access: require breakglass flow — temp-unmask link with 2FA & audit note + legal sign-off. store who unmasked and reason
maria: edge-case: multipart requests where attachment is base64 in JSON field; need scrub heuristics
cheng: scrub heuristics: if field size > X or mime type in [image, pdf] then treat as attachment. also HMAC filename fingerprinting
sara: need copy in docs & API: explain what "link_only" vs "hash_only" vs "full" mean
maria: ok. i'll open RFC and a console mock for the toggle. can we land the metric + safe default to on?
noah: yes default on, sample_rate conservative. I'll draft the security checklist
cheng: I'll add the server-side guard so inspect-mode never auto-uploads raw attachments. patch incoming
sara: thanks team :thumbsup:
maria: filing RFC: https://internal.redwood/rfcs/ATTACH-SAMPLE-92
deploy-bot: canary deployed to cluster-a at 3901234589
maria: resolved for now, followups in RFC and PRs
